issues.title: Export button unresponsive on tablet layout
issues.detail: Reproduces on a 10-inch tablet only; CSApp marks this export itself as a partial/incremental batch (see the accompanying note — this manifest models the source producer flagging the export run as partial, which surfaces as IMPORT_PARTIAL_SOURCE at Validate time, requiring explicit partial-import confirmation before Preview).
